verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions an official Unleash CLI. The Admin API, the MCP server for coding assistants, the SDKs and the Docker deployment are adjacent capabilities or developer building blocks, not a first-party command-line tool. A feature-flag platform could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence means none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
